description: This file defines the RelaceApi class, an adapter for interacting with the Relace API for language model operations such as chat completion and code application. It includes methods for streaming chat completions, converting requests to Relace format, and handling API responses.

classes.name: RelaceApi
classes.description: A class implementing the BaseLlmApi interface to interact with the Relace API for language model operations.

methods.name: chatCompletionNonStream
methods.description: Performs a non-streaming chat completion by converting to streaming format internally.

methods.name: chatCompletionStream
methods.description: Streams chat completion chunks from the Relace API, converting input and processing the response.

methods.name: completionNonStream
methods.description: Throws an error as non-streaming completion is not supported.

methods.name: completionStream
methods.description: Throws an error as streaming completion is not supported.

methods.name: fimStream
methods.description: Throws an error as FIM streaming is not supported.

methods.name: rerank
methods.description: Throws an error as reranking is not supported.

methods.name: list
methods.description: Throws an error as model listing is not supported.
